summary: An asset holding the live list of active instances, kept current by the objects themselves.
overview: Tracks something like "all active enemies". Objects add and remove themselves as they enable and disable, so anything holding this asset always sees the current set without a FindObjectsOfType scan.
useCases: Finding the nearest enemy without scanning the scene.
A live count for a wave or objective UI.
Iterating every active pickup to apply a global effect.

gotchas.title: It is an asset, so it survives leaving Play mode
gotchas.body: With Domain Reload disabled, stale entries can persist into the next session. Clearing on start is the usual safeguard.

gotchas.title: Registration order is spawn order, not a sort
gotchas.body: The list reflects when things enabled. Anything needing nearest or strongest has to sort it.
